title: Parity Conjectures for Elliptic Curves over Number Fields
exact_target: For an elliptic curve $E$ over a number field $K$, do the parity conjectures hold: assuming finiteness of the Tate–Shafarevich group, is $(-1)^{\operatorname{rank}E(K)}=w(E/K)$, and, for every prime $p$, is the corresponding $p$-Selmer-rank parity equal to $w(E/K)$? The stronger version asks for the rank-parity equality without assuming finiteness of the Tate–Shafarevich group.
